sql: SELECT o.order_id,o.book_id,o.network_id,o.mint,o.pool,o.state,o.reason,o.requested_at,o.filled_at,o.closed_at,o.spend_usd,o.exit_usd,o.costs_usd,o.exit_reason,o.qty,o.entry_price_usd,o.peak_value_usd,(SELECT count(*) FROM marks m WHERE m.order_id=o.order_id) AS marks_n,(SELECT price_usd FROM marks m WHERE m.order_id=o.order_id ORDER BY m.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS mark_price,(SELECT value_usd FROM marks m WHERE m.order_id=o.order_id ORDER BY m.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS mark_value,(SELECT at FROM marks m WHERE m.order_id=o.order_id ORDER BY m.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS mark_at FROM orders o ORDER BY o.requested_at DESC

SELECT o.order_id,o.book_id,o.network_id,o.mint,o.pool,o.state,o.reason,o.requested_at,o.filled_at,o.closed_at,o.spend_usd,o.exit_usd,o.costs_usd,o.exit_reason,NULL AS qty,o.entry_unit_price_usd AS entry_price_usd,NULL AS peak_value_usd,o.ticker,(SELECT count(*) FROM marks m WHERE m.order_id=o.order_id) AS marks_n,NULL AS mark_price,NULL AS mark_value,(SELECT CAST(lamports AS REAL)/1e9 FROM marks m WHERE m.order_id=o.order_id AND m.lamports IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS mark_sol,(SELECT at FROM marks m WHERE m.order_id=o.order_id ORDER BY m.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS mark_at FROM orders o ORDER BY o.requested_at DESC

capital.sql: SELECT book_id,at,kind,usd,note FROM capital_flows ORDER BY at

sql: SELECT request_id,kind,outcome,reason,at FROM request_outcomes ORDER BY at DESC
SELECT (SELECT max(at) FROM marks) AS last_mark_at,(SELECT max(at) FROM request_outcomes) AS last_outcome_at,(SELECT max(at) FROM fill_attempts) AS last_attempt_at
SELECT (SELECT max(at) FROM marks) AS last_mark_at,(SELECT max(at) FROM request_outcomes) AS last_outcome_at,NULL AS last_attempt_at

requests.sql: SELECT request_id,kind,epoch_id,actor_id,at,ticket_id,network_id,mint,pool,order_id,reason,detail_json FROM desk_paper_requests ORDER BY at DESC

halts.sql: SELECT seq,epoch_id,action,actor_id,reason,at FROM desk_halts ORDER BY seq DESC

candidates.sql: SELECT epoch_id,network_id,mint,pool,actor_id,known_at,corrected_known_at FROM desk_candidates ORDER BY known_at DESC

feed_filters.sql: SELECT seq,epoch_id,actor_id,at,rules_json,reason FROM desk_feed_filters ORDER BY seq DESC

results_reads.sql: SELECT epoch_id,actor_id,sha256,first_at,last_at,items_n,reads FROM desk_results_reads ORDER BY last_at DESC

tool_counts.sql: SELECT actor_id,json_extract(refs_json,'$.tool') AS tool,count(*) AS n,max(corrected_at) AS at FROM office_v2_events WHERE kind='tool_call' GROUP BY actor_id,tool ORDER BY n DESC

visits.sql: SELECT actor_id,corrected_at AS at,json_extract(refs_json,'$.host') AS host,json_extract(refs_json,'$.path') AS path FROM office_v2_events WHERE kind='browser_visit' ORDER BY seq DESC

standups.sql: SELECT actor_id,corrected_at AS at,text FROM office_v2_events WHERE kind='standup' ORDER BY seq DESC

notebooks.sql: SELECT e.actor_id,e.corrected_at AS at,json_extract(e.refs_json,'$.notebook_text') AS text FROM office_v2_events e WHERE e.kind='workspace' AND e.seq=(SELECT max(seq) FROM office_v2_events w WHERE w.kind='workspace' AND w.actor_id=e.actor_id)

wakes.sql: SELECT actor_id,ended_at AS at,used,state,json_extract(payload_json,'$.model') AS model,json_extract(payload_json,'$.outcome') AS outcome,json_extract(payload_json,'$.started_at') AS started_at FROM quota_wakes ORDER BY ended_at DESC

sql: SELECT at,price_usd,value_usd FROM (SELECT at,price_usd,value_usd FROM marks WHERE order_id=? ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 400) ORDER BY at

SELECT at,NULL AS price_usd,NULL AS value_usd,value_sol FROM (SELECT at,CAST(lamports AS REAL)/1e9 AS value_sol FROM marks WHERE order_id=? AND lamports IS NOT NULL ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 400) ORDER BY at
SELECT ticket_id,network_id,mint,stage,verdict,reason,seat,ts FROM desk_tickets ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT ticket_id,network_id,mint,stage,verdict,reason,NULL AS seat,ts FROM desk_tickets ORDER BY id DESC

ticket_counts.sql: SELECT verdict,count(*) AS n,max(ts) AS ts FROM desk_tickets WHERE stage='hard_filter' GROUP BY verdict
